title: Orange Infused Egyptian Orange Pilaf
description: A malty, chewy, and light Egyptian dish featuring orange and bhuna, made in a donabe vessel with ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients
instructions: Rinse the Egyptian rice in a fine mesh sieve until the water runs clear
In a donabe vessel, heat the ghee over medium heat
Add the bhuna spice mix and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly
Add the orange zest and cook for another minute, stirring constantly
Add the rice to the donabe vessel and stir to coat with the spice mixture
Add the orange juice, salt, and black pepper to the donabe vessel and bring to a boil
Reduce the heat to low, cover the donabe vessel, and simmer for 20 minutes
Turn off the heat and let the pilaf rest, covered, for 5 minutes
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired
